meta.description: Coverage ledger v4: added liveStatus (Discord testing status) and siblings (family relationships for class-level investigation) per region. Incidents stored separately in coverage-incidents.json.

squad-submission.name: Squad Submission
squad-submission.notes: setup-regions-tests: customId parsing (squad_modal_{gameId}_{playerNum}), squad structure validation (dcList/ccList/name), DC data integrity (40pt squads buildable, all DCs have cost/affiliation), CC deck completeness (15-card decks from 293 CCs), hasDcInSquad bracketed name detection.

map-selection.name: Map Selection
map-selection.notes: setup-regions-tests: customId format parsing (5 prefixes), state fields (selectedMap, mapSelected), handler registration (handleMapSelection/handleMapTypeChoice/handleMapConfirm exported), map registry data validation (id/name on all maps), deployment zone data presence.

initiative.name: Initiative Determination
initiative.notes: Deep tests: Devious Scheme all 4 cases, initiative determination, round flipping. initiative-tests + cc-play-deep coverage.

zone-selection.name: Zone Selection
zone-selection.notes: Real handleDeploymentZone exercised. Always picks red — blue never tested. 2000/2000 pass. Production fix: getFootprintCells wrapper.

attachment-placement.name: Attachment Placement
attachment-placement.notes: 10 targeted tests: state machine (pending structure, apply moves card, redo restores), customId parsing (setup_attach_to, attach_confirm, attach_reselect, attach_done_confirm, attach_done_redo), dual-player confirm gate, pendingAttachConfirm temporary selection. Handler registration verified.
liveIncidents: Attachment ordering bugs reported in live games

auto-deploy.name: Auto Deploy
auto-deploy.notes: Real handleAutoDeploy exercised with 171 DCs across 6 maps. Large figures (1x2, 2x3) covered after getFootprintCells fix. 2000/2000 pass.

manual-deployment.name: Manual Deployment
manual-deployment.notes: setup-regions-tests: customId format parsing (9+ prefixes: deployment_fig, deploy_pick, deploy_row, deploy_row_back, deployment_orient, loadout_pick, form_pick, deployment_done, auto_deploy), state fields (figurePositions, playerZones), handler registration, loadout cards data (Purge Trooper), form cards data (Clawdite Shapeshifter).

companion-deployment.name: Companion Deployment
companion-deployment.notes: setup-regions-tests: companion data validation (The Child, Dio, J4X-7, Junk Droid, BD-1, Salacious B. Crumb exist in dc-effects), companionHostMap structure, companion figureKey format (Name-0-0), companion cost (0 or undefined), post-deploy handler registration.

post-deploy-abilities.name: Post-Deploy Abilities
post-deploy-abilities.notes: 55 tests across 9 suites, all 12 ability families covered end-to-end. Auto-apply: Beskar Armor, Stealthy, Ambush, Security Detail (single leader). Interactive: Security Detail (multi leader), Forward Emplacement, Arms Distribution, Strike Team (Cassian), Smooth Landing (Bodhi Rook), Extra Armor (skirmish upgrade), Scavenged Walker (attachment). 2 production bugs found and fixed. Setup harness supports attachments config.

cc-draw.name: CC Draw
cc-draw.notes: Real handleCcShuffleDraw + handleIKnowEverythingKeep (Moff Gideon). Shuffle, draw 3, channel validation all covered. 2000/2000 pass.

activate-dc.name: DC Activation
activate-dc.notes: activation-combat-deep-tests: DC activation state machine, available actions, action counting, customId parsing. Flow harness + GS-1/GS-2 invariants.

movement.name: Movement
movement.notes: Flow harness exercises dc_move, move_mp, move_pick. Synthetic start positions. Grid/adjacency logic exercised but not from real deployment positions.

attack-declaration.name: Attack Declaration
attack-declaration.notes: Deep tests: weapon choice data, arsenal selection, attack target customId. dark-chain-tests + cc-play-deep coverage.

interact-objectives.name: Interact / Objectives
interact-objectives.notes: Deep tests: terminal/door/contraband interactions, VP scoring. interact-objectives-tests + cc-play-deep coverage.

special-ability-flows.name: Special Abilities (Triggered)
special-ability-flows.notes: Deep tests: ability lookup, choice resolution state machine, DC special triggers. dark-chain-tests + cc-play-deep coverage.

cc-play.name: Command Card Play
cc-play.notes: Deep tests: isCcPlayableNow with all timing categories, blocking flags (shadowOps/criticalHit/commsJammer), per-instance limits, Assassinate lockout, getPlayableCcFromHand filtering, specialAction exclusion. 32 cc-timing + cc-play-deep coverage.

combat-lifecycle.name: Combat Lifecycle
combat-lifecycle.notes: round-lifecycle-tests: combat object structure validation (all required fields), p1Ready/p2Ready both-player gate, reroll tracking arrays (attackerRerolledIndices/defenderRerolledIndices), False Orders delegation (falseOrdersControllerPlayerNum). CustomId parsing (combat_ready, combat_roll, combat_resolve_ready, attack_target). Handler exports verified. Flow harness + GS-3/GS-4.

surge-spending.name: Surge Spending
surge-spending.notes: round-lifecycle-tests: surge accumulation (surgeDamage/surgePierce/surgeAccuracy), surgeRemaining decrement, double-cost surges, surgeConditions array, special flags (surgePreventBleed, surgeCancelDodge, autofireChainPending). CustomId parsing (combat_surge_{gameId}_{choice}: done/index/bleed_prevention/rogue_one). Handler exports verified. Flow harness + sim-farm.

reroll.name: Reroll
reroll.notes: Deep tests: reroll state machine, indices tracking, dedup, forced queue. 6 combat-effects + activation-combat-deep coverage.

combat-interrupts.name: Combat Interrupts (CCs)
combat-interrupts.notes: Deep tests: Negation/Celebration/StrikeMeDown lifecycle, pending structures, play/resolve flows. 9 combat-effects + activation-combat-deep coverage.

strain-choice.name: Strain Choice
strain-choice.notes: Deep tests: strain as damage vs CC discard, pendingStrainChoice structure, customId parsing. combat-effects + activation-combat-deep coverage.

conditions.name: Conditions (Bleed/Stun/Weaken)
conditions.notes: Deep tests: condition apply/remove/reset/immunity, Bleed/Stun/Weaken specifics, HARMFUL_CONDITIONS enum. 13 combat-effects + activation-combat-deep coverage.

token-overflow.name: Token Overflow
token-overflow.notes: Deep tests: power token cap, overflow choice, grant beyond cap. combat-effects + activation-combat-deep coverage.

push-pull.name: Push / Pull / Displacement
push-pull.notes: Deep tests: displacement rules, Massive push, Cover Fire/Spread the Pain. push-pull-tests + activation-combat-deep coverage.

end-activation.name: End Activation / Turn Switch
end-activation.notes: round-lifecycle-tests: cleanupActivation removes all ACTIVATION_MSGID_FLAGS (86 flags verified), ACTIVATION_FIGKEY_FLAGS, ACTIVATION_PLAYERNUM_FLAGS, ACTIVATION_SCALAR_FLAGS. CustomId parsing (end_turn, pass_activation_turn). State fields (dcFinishedPinged, lastActivationMsgIdByPlayer, currentActivationTurnPlayerId). Handler exports verified. Flow harness + GS-5 invariant coverage.

round-transition.name: Round Transition
round-transition.notes: round-lifecycle-tests: cleanupRoundStart resets all ROUND_OBJECT_FLAGS→{}, ROUND_NULL_FLAGS→null, ROUND_ARRAY_FLAGS→[], ROUND_FALSE_FLAGS→false, ROUND_DELETE_FLAGS deleted. Phase transitions validated (START_OF_ROUND→ACTIVATION→END_OF_ROUND cycle). setPhase/setRoundPhase validation. CustomId parsing. State fields (currentRound, endOfRoundWhoseTurn, startOfRoundWhoseTurn). Handler exports verified.

phase-gates.name: Phase Gates
phase-gates.notes: Both harnesses exercise phase_gate_ready for deploy_done, cc_drawn, pre_activation, post_start_of_round gates. Real handler chain. Dual-player ready logic verified.

forfeit-game-over.name: Forfeit / Game Over
forfeit-game-over.notes: Deep tests: VP thresholds, elimination, tiebreaker chain, forfeit flow, game cleanup. win-conditions-tests + cc-play-deep coverage.

hand-private-surfaces.name: Hand / Private Surfaces
hand-private-surfaces.notes: DS-1 invariant verifies CC hand cards don't leak to shared surface. DS-2/DS-3 track surface model consistency. 5 targeted tests: bold CC name leak detection, plain text non-leak, separate hand arrays, hand size, play-removes-from-hand. Actual Discord thread routing not verified — data model checks only.

wrong-player-routing.name: Wrong-Player Routing
wrong-player-routing.notes: DS-5 invariant checks that actions don't appear in wrong player's available-actions surface. Detects some routing bugs but not all (e.g., followUp sent to wrong channel).

hidden-info-leak.name: Hidden Info Leak Prevention
hidden-info-leak.notes: DS-1 invariant checks CC hand cards don't leak to shared surface. Found 1 real leak in 500 flow sims (seed=493, Take Cover via dc_special). That leak is a verified detection — DS-1 caught a real bug.
liveIncidents: DS-1 violation: Take Cover leaked via dc_special followUp

stale-component.name: Stale Component Cleanup
stale-component.notes: DS-7 checks for cleanup after state transitions. DS-9 checks for stale buttons remaining after phase changes. 4 targeted tests: pendingCombat/pendingNegation/moveInProgress/pendingCcConfirmation lifecycle create→clear patterns. Surface model invariants.

payload-shape.name: Payload Shape Limits
payload-shape.notes: 37 targeted tests: validatePayloadShape boundary tests (action rows 5/6, buttons 5/6, select 25/26/0, customId 100/101, content 2000/2001, embed title/desc/fields/field-name/field-value at limits, combo violations). Real-world payload simulations (DC action menu, surge menu, deploy picker). DC/CC name length validation. DS-8/DS-10 fire every flow sim step.

timing-concurrency.name: Timing / Concurrency
timing-concurrency.notes: Race conditions from concurrent button clicks. async-mutex used in production. Not testable in headless (single-threaded sequential dispatch).
